mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS shows a downward trend (3-month rolling change < 0), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS show positive monthly changes, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of slowing industrial production (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), manufacturing weakness signals reduced corporate earnings potential, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% annually, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL shows a positive 3-month trend, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,200,000 units (HOUST > 1200), it signals robust residential construction activity and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS shows a positive 3-month trend, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0 (index 2017=100), it indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
